title: Unique Domains for Python: a typed client for the Unique Domains API
description:
uniquedomains is the Python client of the Unique Domains API, which answers questions about domain names: whether a name is taken, what its registry record says, what registrars charge for each ending, and what the domain market did.

The client is generated from the API's OpenAPI document. Every operation is a typed method and every answer is a typed model. Install it with pip install uniquedomains, on Python 3.11 or later.

Without a key, the API answers 62 of its 87 operations, 20 rows a page, within 60 calls an hour and 100 a day from one address. The other 25 operations need a key. Documentation: https://unique.domains/api.
